risks.title: Economic Fluctuations and Investment Cycles
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to residential and commercial investment cycles, interest rate fluctuations, commodity price fluctuations and global economic conditions. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Tariffs and Trade Policy
risks.score_rationale: Since Q1 2025, additional tariffs impact costs and margins. The company has implemented price increases that reduce demand. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Supply Chain Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on supply chain, exposed to disruptions and price fluctuations in commodities and components. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Commodity Price and Component Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in steel, copper, aluminum and electronic component prices. Recent acquisitions increase exposure to volatile battery cells. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Competition Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in competitive markets: residential, commercial, industrial, data centers. Mentioned in Item 1 Business.

risks.title: Debt Structure Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company carries significant debt with credit obligations. In July 2025, amendment to Term Loan A and Revolving Credit Facility. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A Note 12.

risks.title: Geopolitical Instability and Currency Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: International operations expose the company to regional conflicts, currency risks and political uncertainties. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Impact of Renewable Energy Mandates and Tax Incentive Changes
risks.score_rationale: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) of July 2025 accelerated phase-out of certain investment tax credits, negatively impacting the solar storage market. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.
